modelDescription: A tack-driving, bolt-action rimfire, the Model 93R17 FXP features Savage Arms legendary user-adjustable AccuTrigger technology. The carbon steel barrel is button rifled and paired with a rugged, matte black synthetic stock. Weighing just 6 pounds, the rifle has a 5-round detachable box magazine.
